name: wood-league-app-css
description: CSS-only toolchain for the Wood League Django app: compiles static/css/main.css (Tailwind v4 source) into the committed static/css/tailwind.css that base.html serves. Not a Node app — Railway deploys via the Python (RAILPACK) builder and never runs this. See bin/build_tailwind.sh and the css-staleness CI guard (#140).
